1	# Changelog
2	
3	All notable changes to DotState will be documented in this file.
4	
5	The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.0.0/),
6	and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).
7	
8	## [Unreleased]
9	
10	---
11	
12	## [0.4.0] - 2026-05-30
13	
14	### Added
15	
16	- **Git**: Support for repositories using the SHA-256 object format (#35). DotState previously failed to open them with "unknown object format sha256". Enabled via git2 0.21's experimental `unstable-sha256` feature; SHA-256 hashing is routed through thread-safe vendored OpenSSL (`https` feature). When you add a local SHA-256 repo during setup, a confirmation popup warns that support is experimental and asks you to confirm before proceeding, and `doctor` flags already-configured SHA-256 repos.
17	
18	### Changed
19	
20	- **Dependencies**: Upgraded `git2` from 0.20 to 0.21. Adapted to its API changes (`Remote::url`, `Reference::name`, and `StatusEntry::path` now return `Result` instead of `Option`).
21	
22	---
23	
24	## [0.3.4] - 2026-05-17
25	
26	### Fixed
27	
28	- **Form Popups**: Enforce a minimum size and render a "Terminal too small" fallback so Create/Rename Profile, Add/Edit Package, Import, Profile Selection, and File Browser popups no longer silently collapse their inner fields on short terminals (#53)
29	- **Theme Contrast**: Recalibrated `text_muted`, `text_placeholder`, and `border` across every preset to clear WCAG 3:1 against the popup background. Tokyo Night Dark previously rendered labels and unfocused borders at ~1.85:1 / ~1.4:1, nearly invisible on Ghostty. Hierarchy preserved: `text` brightest, `text_muted` ~5:1, `text_placeholder` ~3.5:1 (clearly subordinate to typed text) (#53)
30	- **Manage Profiles**: Page footer is no longer hidden when a popup opens — it now dims behind the modal so the page hotkeys stay visible. Description input gained a placeholder hint
31	- **Text Input**: `TextInput::is_empty()` now checks raw emptiness instead of trimmed, so typed leading whitespace renders visibly rather than as invisible muted placeholder text. Callers needing the old behavior should use `text_trimmed().is_empty()`
32	
33	---
34	
35	## [0.3.3] - 2026-05-16
36	
37	### Added
38	
39	- **CLI**: `dotstate profile` shows the active profile, `dotstate profile list` lists all profiles with active/inactive markers, and `dotstate profile switch <name>` switches and activates a profile from the command line (#50)
40	
41	### Fixed
42	
43	- **Dialog Widget**: Prevent panic (`min > max`) when the terminal is narrower than the dialog's `min_width`; auto-width now degrades gracefully to the available width (#52)
44	- **Package Check**: Honor the user-provided `existence_check` field on custom packages — previously stored but never evaluated, so packages with a custom check were always reported via the binary/manager fallbacks (#51)
45	
46	---
47	
48	## [0.3.2] - 2026-03-30
49	
50	### Added
51	
52	- **Profile Inheritance**: Profiles can now inherit from a parent profile with child-wins override semantics. Multi-level chaining (child → parent → grandparent), cycle detection, delete protection for inherited profiles, and rename propagation across the inheritance chain. Manifest auto-migrates from v1 to v2.
53	- **Manage Profiles UI**: Create popup includes "Inherits From" field with live parent selection; profile details show resolved file counts with source annotations (own / inherited / common)
54	- **CLI**: `list` command groups files by source and shows inheritance chain; `activate` resolves the full inheritance chain
55	
56	### Changed
57	
58	- **Manage Profiles UI**: "Inherits From" and "Copy From" are now mutually exclusive in the create popup — selecting one disables the other with descriptive labels ("live link to parent profile" vs "one-time file copy")
59	- **Docs**: Updated README, website, and CONTRIBUTING.md with profile inheritance documentation
60	
61	### Fixed
62

# Changelog

All notable changes to DotState will be documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.0.0/),

## [0.4.0] - 2026-05-30

### Added

- **Git**: Support for repositories using the SHA-256 object format (#35). DotState previously failed to open them with "unknown object format sha256". Enabled via git2 0.21's experimental `unstable-sha256` feature; SHA-256 hashing is routed through thread-safe vendored OpenSSL (`https` feature). When you add a local SHA-256 repo during setup, a confirmation popup warns that support is experimental and asks you to confirm before proceeding, and `doctor` flags already-configured SHA-256 repos.

### Changed

- **Dependencies**: Upgraded `git2` from 0.20 to 0.21. Adapted to its API changes (`Remote::url`, `Reference::name`, and `StatusEntry::path` now return `Result` instead of `Option`).

---

- **Theme Contrast**: Recalibrated `text_muted`, `text_placeholder`, and `border` across every preset to clear WCAG 3:1 against the popup background. Tokyo Night Dark previously rendered labels and unfocused borders at ~1.85:1 / ~1.4:1, nearly invisible on Ghostty. Hierarchy preserved: `text` brightest, `text_muted` ~5:1, `text_placeholder` ~3.5:1 (clearly subordinate to typed text) (#53)
- **Manage Profiles**: Page footer is no longer hidden when a popup opens — it now dims behind the modal so the page hotkeys stay visible. Description input gained a placeholder hint
- **Text Input**: `TextInput::is_empty()` now checks raw emptiness instead of trimmed, so typed leading whitespace renders visibly rather than as invisible muted placeholder text. Callers needing the old behavior should use `text_trimmed().is_empty()`
